content:
Rae (PM): quick sync  i'm putting together a compact GA operability checklist focused on SLA, monitoring, runbooks, support routing, and a published pricing floor. need owners + any absolute must-not-ship calls before i lock for shiproom.

Jun (Infra): i can own perf validation + autoscale smoke. scope note: p95 <=200ms should be scoped to short chats (<=32 tokens) on standard families. long-sequence mem frag is tracked as tech debt with a mitigation; not GA-blocking.

Lara (SRE): i'll take monitoring, synthetic canaries, and runbooks. must-haves: correctness canary, p99 tail latency alerts, queue-depth/backpressure alarms, and an exercised degraded-model fallback that reroutes to a quantized variant under memory pressure. regional failover drill in CI is required.

Miles (FinOps): i'll publish a GA pricing floor (hosted per-token, embeddings, reserved commits) plus two sample commit scenarios for sales. enterprise discounts can be marked "finalizing" at GA. i'll need 3-5 biz days.

deploy-bot: created ticket OPS-9991 (autoscale-smoke) -> assignee: Jun; OPS-9992 (regional-failover-drill) -> assignee: Lara. :white_check_mark:

Rae (PM): Proposed compact acceptance checklist  react :thumbsup: to accept or call blockers. please call out any absolute "do not ship" items now.

```
GA COMPACT OPERABILITY CHECK (owners)
- SLA: Dedicated 99.9% monthly uptime; Hosted 99.5% initial (owner: Rae)
- Latency guidance: publish p50/p95 per model family; infra target p95 <=200ms for <=32-token requests (owner: Jun)
- Observability: synthetic canaries (latency + correctness), p99 tail and queue/backpressure alerts, traces on sampled requests (owner: Lara)
- Runbooks: SEV1/SEV2 playbooks + throttling and degraded-model fallback procedures tested (owner: Lara)
- Autoscale & Failover: autoscale smoke harness + scripted regional failover CI job (owners: Jun/Lara)
- Docs: GA quickstart, migration notes for pilot customers, operational expectations + pricing FAQ (owner: Rae)
- Support: business-hours triage + documented SEV1 escalation path (owner: Rae)
- Pricing: published GA floor + example commits; enterprise tiers pending (owner: Miles)
```

Jun (Infra): blocking items: autoscale burst validation (1k+ rps synthetic) and KV-cache cold-start regression test. i'll open the smoke PR by Tue.

Lara (SRE): blocking items: regional failover automation in CI and fallback-under-load test. runbooks won't be signed off until those pass.

Miles (FinOps): noted. draft floor and two commit examples by Fri. will include a short blurb explaining pilot->GA delta.

Rae (PM): must-not-ship items we heard: (1) untested fallback under load, (2) no regional-failover CI drill, (3) missing p99/backpressure alerts, (4) no published GA floor. i'll lock this as the shiproom operability floor at 16:00 PT unless anyone raises a hard blocker.

Jun (Infra): :thumbsup: pending autoscale PR.

Lara (SRE): :thumbsup: pending failover + fallback tests.

Miles (FinOps): :thumbsup: (draft incoming).

Rae (PM): thanks all  i'll post the checklist PR and add tickets to the shiproom deck.
